_comment: Default Gurobi parameters of every solve (main.py --gurobi_params overrides them). NoRelHeurTime=120: the no-relaxation heuristic searches integer designs for the first 120 s before branch and bound (2026-10-25).
_source: Speed benchmark 2026-10-24 (tools/speed_bench.py, 3,600 s, 32 cores): 10 cells rho 1 gap 20.3 % -> 1.63 % after 1 h, first design 499 s -> 293 s; 10 cells rho 0.2 proven 349 s -> 657 s (same optimum); lite rho 1 gap 0.48 % -> 0.76 %.

lns._comment: Fix-and-optimize improvement after phase 1 (2026-10-26): phase 1 gets (1 - time_share) of the time limit; then, until the time is used or the gap to the phase-1 bound is <= stop_gap, the placement of a random (1 - free_share) share of the components is fixed to the incumbent and the exact model is re-solved for iter_s seconds; improvements replace the incumbent. Random neighbourhoods only (no structural preference); every design is a feasible design of the full model (lazy constraints active). Not used by the epsilon-constraint Pareto run.

portfolio._comment: Seed portfolio of the robustness sweep (tools/portfolio.py): one job per rho level and seed, the cheapest checked design per level is kept. Benchmark 2026-10-26 (10 cells, rho 1, 1 h): seeds 3 / 1 / 2 reached gaps 0.6 / 1.5 / 20 %; best of three meets the 1 % target.

instances._comment: Training variants of the learned search (learn/instances.py, 2026-10-26): per variant a random subset of the candidate cells (count in 'cells'), rho = 0 with share rho_zero_share else uniform in [0.05, 1], whole chains and single components outside the kept chains left out with a share drawn from removal_share (at least min_components remain; devices leave with their driver), CPU / RAM / ROM / TOPS demands and message sizes scaled by independent factors from demand_factor. The real 10-cell instance is never generated as such: it is the held-out test.

data._comment: Label generation (learn/gen_data.py): every variant solved by the exact model (all uncertainty blocks on, its rho) with time_limit seconds for phase 1 and at least phase2_time for phase 2, then checked. One Slurm array task per per_job variants, parallel solves per task with threads Gurobi threads each, at most max_sessions solves at once (each holds one Gurobi WLS session; about 9 concurrent sessions ran without error on 2026-10-26).

train._comment: Placement predictor (learn/model.py, learn/train.py): heterogeneous graph transformer, hidden width, message-passing layers, attention heads; AdamW; loss = cross entropy of the primary cell + standby_weight x cross entropy of the standby cell + moved_weight x the destroy head's loss; validation share by variant, early stop after patience epochs. unperturbed_share 1.0 and moved_weight 0 (2026-10-27): every training sample is the car without a design, as at the start of a run, so the placement output cannot learn to copy a given design (with 0.3 the validation top-1 read 83 % but was 41 % without a design); the destroy head is not trained.

search._comment: Learned guide of the exact search (learn/search.py, optimizer.py guide; robustness sweep only): the predictor scores every cell per component at the solve's rho. Start (fix_start, 2026-10-27): the predicted placement is repaired for the capacity rules and fixed in the first solve (at most init_s seconds), the exact model fills in the rest; without a design, start_rounds fallback rounds free start_free (cumulative) of the components, least confident first, then the full model until the first design. fix_start false: the prediction is only a MIP start hint of the full search (the behaviour before 2026-10-27). Then the loop frees free_share of the components per iteration (mode: rl = the policy, random / cells / cluster = its controls; partners = communication partners per freed component in cells mode) for iter_s seconds each. Every design passes the lazy constraints of the full model; a fixed-start or restricted phase 1 reports no bound (status GUIDED).

rl._comment: RL of the destroy policy (learn/rl.py): per round episodes_per_round episodes on random training variants (at most max_sessions at once, threads Gurobi threads each), then PPO. Episode: exact solve for init_s from the policy's start design, then max_iters iterations freeing free_share of the components, iter_s seconds of exact re-solve each; reward = cost reduction in % of the start cost.

gate._comment: Gate test (learn/gate.py): the 65-component architecture on cells (more than the 4-12 of the training variants) at rho, every method time_limit seconds with 8 Gurobi threads: the exact model with the default parameters (milp), with MIPFocus=1 (milp_mf1), the learned search (learn.search on in the mode of search_modes, its phases with MIPFocus=1) and its control with the components to free drawn at random (random: same start and loop). search: settings of learn.search for the gate (iter_s 30: one iteration at 20-33 cells needs more than the 10 s of the 4-12 cell training; fix_start false, init_s 420: the neighbourhood comparison starts every method from the same first design of the full search, which needs up to 6 min at 33 cells). seeds: every method once per seed (Gurobi Seed and learn.search seed); the baselines of results/learn/gate_v2 ran before the seeds, with the default seed. Report: best cost at the marks, checker verdict.
